falsifier: OPEN. A generator that only produces plausible output is unfalsifiable. Candidate discipline: it must state what it will NOT generate, and be wrong when that appears.
predict_frame: Generate candidates AND state the class of thing this model claims it will not produce. That negative claim is the only falsifiable part.
assess_frame: Did something appear that this model said it would not generate?
warning: This kind has no proven discipline. Building one is research, not scaffolding.
